title: Fiverr Niche Gig Scraper
description: Type your niches, choose how many gigs you want per niche, click Start. 🎯

niches.title: Niches / Keywords 🎯
niches.sectionDescription: Enter one niche per line. The scraper searches Fiverr for each one.
niches.description: One niche per line, e.g. 'power bi dashboard', 'looker studio dashboard', 'tableau dashboard', 'excel automation'.

gigsPerNiche.title: Gigs per niche 🔢
gigsPerNiche.description: How many gigs to collect for EACH niche. 48 gigs = 1 search page. Max ≈ 2000.

fullDetails.title: Open every gig page for full data 📦
fullDetails.description: ON = visit each gig's page: all 3 packages & prices, description, FAQ, reviews, seller bio, completed orders, response time… (1 request per gig, slower). OFF = fast listing data only.

gigUrls.title: Extra gig URLs (optional) 🔗
gigUrls.description: Specific Fiverr gig URLs to scrape in full, in addition to the niches above.

sortBy.title: Sort By 🔃
sortBy.description: Fiverr sorting order for the search.

dedupeGigs.title: One row per unique gig 🧹
dedupeGigs.description: Fiverr repeats the same gig in an ad slot and an organic slot. ON (recommended) = each gig once. OFF = raw 48 slots per page.

skipPromoted.title: Skip promoted (ad) gigs 🚫
skipPromoted.description: Exclude paid ads so results reflect organic ranking.

maxReviews.title: Reviews per gig 💬
maxReviews.description: Latest reviews to include from each gig page (full-details mode).

includeGallery.title: Include gallery image URLs 🖼️
includeGallery.description: Add all gig image / video URLs to each row.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy 🌐
proxyConfiguration.description: Fiverr is protected by PerimeterX — Apify RESIDENTIAL proxies are strongly recommended.
